phone.title: Prepare your phone
phone.subtitle: Four steps, once per device. Menu names differ a little between brands.

step1.title: Turn on developer mode
step1.pixel: Settings › About phone › tap Build number 7 times and enter your PIN.
step1.samsung: Settings › About phone › Software information › tap Build number 7 times.
step1.xiaomi: Settings › About phone › tap MIUI / OS version 7 times.
step1.other: Settings › About phone › tap Build number 7 times. It may sit under Software information.

step2.title: Enable USB debugging
step2.xiaomi: Settings › Additional settings › Developer options › USB debugging (and Install via USB).

step3.title: Plug in a data cable
step3.text: Charge-only cables are common. If nothing happens, try another cable or port.

step4.title: Allow this computer
step4.text: Unlock the phone, check Always allow, tap Allow.
